answer: The harbor check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Before earning, each identity must complete a verifiable delay function — a computation that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up with more hardware. The tide gate makes time the currency: a thousand clones need a thousand sequential waits, and no amount of parallel machines shortens a single wait. Hold the ember steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
